read.title: Thank You for a Great Year
read.text:
Hi everyone,

As the year comes to an end, I want to take a moment to thank all of you. This year was not easy. We moved to a new office, welcomed six new members, and launched two product lines in overseas markets.

Through it all, you stayed positive and supported one another. I'm especially grateful to the logistics team, who worked extra hours to keep our shipments on schedule during the busy season. Your effort did not go unnoticed.

To celebrate, we will hold a team dinner on Friday, December 12, at 6:30 p.m. Please let Hana know by next Wednesday if you can join.

Thank you again for your hard work and contribution. I'm proud to work with such a great team.

Best regards,
Sarah

write.en: Write a short email to thank a colleague from another team who helped you organize urgent data so you could meet a deadline.
hints: I really appreciate your help with
I couldn't have done it without you
write.model:
Hi Yuna,

I really appreciate your help with the sales data yesterday. Thanks to you, we sent the report to the client on time. I know you were busy with your own work, so I'm even more grateful. Honestly, I couldn't have done it without you. Please let me know if I can help you with anything.

Best regards,
Minsu
